value.rationale: Within-row nearest-neighbor distances in the classical modular Pascal fractal are natural ordered spatial data absent from scalar support counts. The result gives a complete spectrum simultaneously for all primes and depths, with a limiting power-law exponent and sharp moment transition, useful in gap/cluster geometry rather than an arbitrary small case.
